name: A registered-but-unrun agent carries a stale failure as an open defect
description: The 'pi fails inside burrow' defect was reported as current, with a masked cause ('Failed to load extension: path does not exist'). Re-running the exact stored setup on 2026-10-15 succeeded: docker exec -e WARREN_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8084 warren warren run pi-bridge prj_8nh1jacrrqd6 -p 'Reply with exactly: PONG' -> run_5dp2d9p74jmn, state=succeeded, failure_reason=null, provider='bridge', model='deepseek-v4-flash', 2270 in / 3 out tokens, cost $0, 4.4s. All three prior pi-bridge runs are from 2026-10-05 22:51-23:08, each ~9s, failed, failure_reason='no_model_response', provider=null, 0 tokens. Between those dates warren's buildSeedFiles started dropping pi_extensions bodies into .pi/extensions/<name>.ts and burrow's opt-in path started eliding --no-extensions when frontmatter.pi.extensions is true.
